t: Nix Flakes as `normalize.css` for Dev: Selenium Automation on macOS & Linux
s: This article demonstrates using Nix Flakes to create reproducible development environments for Selenium browser automation, ensuring a Python script functions identically across macOS and Linux by managing platform-specific browser driver dependencies.
sub: Nix Flakes for reproducible dev environments
Managing platform-specific browser drivers with Nix
Python script for cross-OS browser control
